caption: A stage's lights are turned up gradually, and the dark set becomes visible piece by piece as the brightness rises.

sa.check: Its lights are turned up gradually.
The set becomes visible piece by piece as the brightness rises.
Shadows appear away from the lamps.

pc.expect: The scene brightens smoothly with no jumps and does not brighten before the lights come up.
pc.fail: It jumps to full; or flickers; or it is lit before the lights rise.

pc.expect: Shadows appear away from the lamps.
pc.fail: Shadows point toward the lamps; or in several directions under one lamp; or there are none.
Set pieces move; or the lit area wanders; or a lamp swings.
The set changes colour as it brightens; or the lights change colour; or the backdrop changes.

pc.expect: The set pieces keep their number.
pc.fail: A piece vanishes; or appears; or a lamp duplicates.
Pieces rearrange; or the backdrop changes; or the stage changes.

note: Illumination: the on/off causality of electric lights belongs to Electricity; here only where the light goes once it exists is judged.
